answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake that vests over epochs, like sediment settling into shale: a new key can answer, but its grades only count after its stake has sat untouched through several closes. A sybil farm must then fund each fake from its own balance, and slashing one key burns only that key's stake, not the whole reef of honest identities. Cheap copies stop being cheap because each one carries its own locked cost, while a single honest agent standing on a mesa of earned attestations keeps full weight without paying again.
